description: Check the backlog of your durable queues: each one's live counts (ready, delayed, leased, dead, total, bytes) and settings. A lease that ran out counts as ready, or dead after max_attempts claims. Without queue: all queues, plus plan_bytes and plan_max_bytes. With queue: that queue, or queue_not_found. No message bodies: queue_claim takes work, queue_dead lists dead letters. Works after the plan ended.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

queue.description: Only this queue, with its settings.

name: queue_status
title: Show my queues
